contract: Shopping Cart (/cart) Opsi 2 Two-Section Mobile Card layout eliminating horizontal slide (scrollWidth === clientWidth === 343px, overflow-x: hidden, min-width: 0) while preserving 100% of the Desktop (> 768px) table layout.

accessibility.evidence: Remove button (28x28px) and quantity controls (96x34px box with 28x28px buttons) are directly visible and reachable inside the 343px mobile card without horizontal scrolling.

responsive.evidence: Mobile 375x812: scrollDivClientWidth=343px, scrollDivScrollWidth=343px, isHorizontallyScrollable=false (reduced from 648px to 343px). Desktop 1440x900: 100% unchanged (tableWrapper=840x350px, table=838x269px, firstRow=838x109px, totalCard=360x410px).

loading.reason: Cart state is read synchronously from localStorage (window.cart) on DOMContentLoaded.

empty.evidence: .empty-cart-page renders 'Keranjang belanja Anda kosong' and 'Pergi ke Toko' button when cartItems.length === 0.

error.evidence: .cart-stock-warning (#cartQtyWarning_<id>) displays stock limit warning when user increments quantity to maxStock.

partial.evidence: Products with and without custom_text render cleanly in both mobile card and desktop table layouts.

success.evidence: Quantity increment/decrement, item removal, subtotal calculation, and Proceed to Checkout link work across mobile and desktop.

permission.reason: Shopping cart view (/cart) is accessible to customers without special role permission gates.

renderedEvidence.observation: Non-slideable Two-Section Mobile Card (343px width, 0px horizontal scroll) showing image, wrapped product title, unit price, top-right remove button, and bottom dashed row with Jumlah Pesanan, Subtotal, and (- qty +) controls.
Desktop 2-column layout (840px table wrapper + 360px Cart Totals card) preserved 100% unchanged.
